crops.text: (WOF) The opponent chooses the result of all coin flips and dice rolls.(1CD) Generate a Salt.(AAT) If any attack, ability usage, or infliction fails to hit the targeted creature, is negated, or an immunity prevents it from occurring, generate a Salt.(AAT) If a friendly prime creature is defeated before it takes its first turn, generate 3 Salt.(WOF) All enemy creatures cannot have their stats increased by more than 2 bars above the value written on the card.
